feature: Driver-controlled DMN routing, reroute and countdown preferences
status: research contract, not a finished Android UI or live navigation controller

controls.label: Preferred route
controls.description: Fastest uses reliable ETA, shortest uses distance, balanced evaluates both and maneuver complexity.

controls.label: Automatic alternative proposals
controls.description: Always faster means any reliably faster travel-time alternative, even when Shortest is the preferred search mode; blocked only means verified closure; intelligent is default.

controls.label: When to offer alternatives
controls.description: Any measured benefit, fixed threshold, or adaptive benefit considering journey time and maneuver complexity.

controls.label: Switch countdown
controls.description: Fixed driver-specified delay or adaptive countdown, subject to safe maneuver lead time.

controls.label: Automatically switch after countdown
controls.description: Enabled by default; only when the candidate remains legal, current and safe.

controls.label: Reduce unnecessary difficult maneuvers
controls.description: Balanced route preference and intelligent rerouting consider verified maneuver complexity.

non_overrideable_rules: never force prohibited turns or U-turns
safe maneuver lead and revalidation at switch time
unknown legality cannot be treated as confirmed legal
future_android_integration: existing DriveMate Android application, isolated integration branch, subject to owner approval and full robot/CI gates
thresholds_notice: The thresholds and objective weights are provisional research defaults, not independently measured optimal values.
